summary: Caldwell County, KY steel lookout tower near Princeton; NGS described it in 1962 as 80 ft; Forest Lookouts marks it removed. No build or removal dates found.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey first observed the station, which sits at the center of the tower top, and described the tower

notes_for_editor: The only dated source is the 1962 NGS station description; it does not give a build date. The Forest Lookouts page is the only source for removed status. The Kentucky pages we could read on the NHLR and FFLOS sites do not mention Asher. A search snippet about a tower at Asher's Fork (a Facebook group post) is a different place and was not used. The brief said gone; the page says Removed, so the record uses removed. No photos found. No visit or access information found.
